label: Presentation: Presents r f is a proposed truth-preserving cognitive presentation of object f by r…
definition: Presents r f is a proposed truth-preserving cognitive presentation of object f by r, not necessarily likeness, identity or a physical part. Its epistemic warrant is an open premise. MediatedTransfer explicitly requires successful Direct access to it.
note: Additive interface for issue #259. Parmenides 130e–131e and 133b–134e, Phaedo 74b–d / 100d–e and Aristotle Metaphysics I.9 motivate these contrasts; none defines the modern typed interface. Sourcing a replacement would require a passage fixing this exact scope.
